metadata.description: Saves the "PTU usage by APIM subscription" workbook in this resource group. It creates a new workbook named for this version and does not change APIM, Azure OpenAI, or Foundry resources.
Name shown in Monitor > Workbooks. Each release has its own default name, so deploying it creates a new workbook and leaves existing copies untouched.
Derived from the name and resource group. Deploying the same version again updates that version's workbook; a new release creates a separate one.
